audience: online sellers and warehouse teams who run stock, orders and contacts in Jubelio

useCases.title: Check stock by location and sales channel
useCases.text: List the stock of each product, by location and by sales channel. Find one product by its SKU to read its stock.

useCases.title: Review completed, cancelled and failed orders
useCases.text: List sales orders in one state: completed, cancelled, failed or returned. Open one order to read its items, totals and cancel reason.

useCases.title: Follow invoices and payment state
useCases.text: List sales invoices with their number, customer, totals and payment state. Open one invoice to read its lines and payments.

useCases.title: Track purchase orders from suppliers
useCases.text: List purchase orders with supplier, totals and receive state. Open one order to read its items and totals.

useCases.title: Add a customer or edit a contact
useCases.text: Create a customer or vendor contact, or edit one. Read an existing contact first, because an edit can clear fields you leave out.
